organization.notes: Commercial project steward; official pricing FAQ says serving businesses since2017 (product launch basis; company incorporation unverified). Official January2021 post confirms $500,000 investment without naming investors. The fund’s audited2025 financial statements identify an equity holding in Akaunting Yazılım A.Ş.; recorded as historical at31December2025, not a verified current cap table. Other names seen only in secondary leads remain unverified.

pricingTiers.name: Standard On-Premise
pricingTiers.notes: One company, one user plus one accountant, 1,000 invoices. Current BSL limits apply; not OSI OSS. Apps purchased separately.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.

pricingTiers.name: Premium On-Premise
pricingTiers.notes: Closest small-business plan: 10 companies, 10 users, 10,000 invoices. Annual and alternative lifetime prices shown separately; apps not included.

pricingTiers.name: Ultimate On-Premise
pricingTiers.notes: Highest on-premise plan for accountants, not a named enterprise offer. Official pricing card shows $684/year or $7,224 lifetime; official Help Center table conflicts at $504/$5,292. Amounts withheld pending vendor clarification.

moats.claim: Modular financial workflows and third-party app extensions can increase customization switching costs, though key accounting functions depend on add-ons.

productReasons.claim: Recurring payment reminders and multi-currency records help coordinate invoice collection across customers.
Multiple bank accounts and bank-transaction imports support consolidating cash activity.
Customer, vendor and product records plus an app marketplace allow bookkeeping workflows to expand into adjacent operations.

sponsorship.notes: No separate corporate financial/in-kind sponsor identified in reviewed official project and business pages. Verified commercial steward included as business fallback; customers, partners and investors are not classified as sponsors.

requirements.notes: Installation guide gives MySQL/MariaDB default path.

requirements.component: Apache, Nginx or IIS with URL rewriting
requirements.notes: One compatible web server; alternatives, not all required.
Composer installs PHP dependencies; Node/npm build assets, not external runtime services.

options.name: Softaculous Akaunting
options.notes: Official 2017 announcement links installer; current marketplace lists Akaunting 3.2.3. Requires Softaculous-enabled hosting; verify version before installation.

oneClickInstall.notes: Verified options listed; manual multi-step installation and Docker Compose alone are not treated as one-click.
